title: Child emergency
summary: Stay calm. Children can get worse quickly, so get help early.
doSteps: Keep the child with a parent or someone they know.
If they are choking and cannot breathe, give firm back blows between the shoulder blades.
If they have a high fever, remove extra clothing and keep them cool.
If they have a fit, move hard objects away and lay them on their side when it stops.
Bring any medicines the child takes.
dontSteps: Do not put anything in their mouth during a fit.
Do not shake a baby or child.
